headline: GW9: A Concise 30-Minute Guide | Updated 8 Hours Before Deadline (Latest Stats & Injury News)
body: Just finished my GW9 guide with only 8 hours until the deadline, so all the stats, injury updates and transfer recommendations are as fresh as possible! I've tried to cut out the chaff and keep everything concise. Each positional bracket is covered with stats per 90 for defcon, shots, goal involvement and expected stats, including their fixtures and my rating for each. No written guide this week unfortunately, as there isn't enough time before the deadline. Hope it helps with your final decisions. Good luck, should be an interesting week before the big Brighton, Arsenal, Leeds fixture swings!   submitted by   /u/speardrops [link]   [comments]
